segments.text: the state level, to enable Frederick County and other counties to reassert our right to be
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: governed by we, the people, putting more power directly in the hands of the residents. I call
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: for this board to expand public referendums on key issues, giving every resident a meaningful
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: voice in our governance beyond elections alone. Our county should be guided by local wisdom rather
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: than external consultations. One such key issue is tax revenue. We need protectionist tax policy
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: to make revenue and safeguard our resources, ensuring non-residents who benefit from our
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: lands contribute more equitably through significantly higher taxes, while rewarding
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: long-term owners with substantial relief. For instance, non-resident landowners could face
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: up to 40 to 50 percent surcharge on property taxes, while long-term stewards,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: could receive up to 90 percent relief. This invites a broad and sweeping tax restructuring
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: at the county level, tailored to secure our economic independence and prosperity.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: The Frederick County Board of Supervisors should form a tax policy restructuring working group,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: composed of citizens and public officials, to prepare and propose a public referendum
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: for the next 2026 elections. This group would craft a comprehensive plan based on the protectionist
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: principles I mentioned, ensuring it's ready for the people of Frederick County to decide directly.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: We'll need to advocate for state-level changes to make this possible, but should not be deterred
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: from enacting the will of we the people, should we so choose, and if the advocacy falls short.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: I would be happy to lead or serve on such a working group. For any Frederick County citizen

segments.text: who might be listening, I call for support of leaders who champion Frederick County first and
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: foremost, seek out candidates dedicated to our well-being, ready to navigate any changes with
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_07

segments.text: vision and strong leadership. This calls for collaboration and innovation from all of us.

segments.text: If you're a resident or board member and agree with any ideas I've expressed here,

segments.text: please amplify your voice, call for referendums on such vital topics that will shape our future.
